keyEvents.text: Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Elversberg 1, Mainz 0. Felix Keidel (Elversberg) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Elversberg 2, Mainz 0. Francis Onyeka (Elversberg) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by David Mokwa.
Danny da Costa (Mainz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Elversberg 3, Mainz 0. Maurice Krattenmacher (Elversberg) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Substitution, Mainz. Benedict Hollerbach replaces Nadiem Amiri.
Substitution, Mainz. Ransford Königsdörffer replaces Phillip Tietz.
Substitution, Mainz. Silvan Widmer replaces Phillipp Mwene.
Substitution, Mainz. Lennard Maloney replaces Paul Nebel.
Substitution, Elversberg. Nicholas Mickelson replaces Lasse Günther.
Delay in match (Elversberg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ransford Königsdörffer (Mainz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Nicolas Kristof (Elversberg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Elversberg. Frederik Schmahl replaces Francis Onyeka.
Substitution, Elversberg. Cole Campbell replaces Maurice Krattenmacher.
Stefan Posch (Mainz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Mainz. Eric Martel replaces Kaishu Sano.
Substitution, Elversberg. Luca Schnellbacher replaces David Mokwa.
Substitution, Elversberg. Raif Adam replaces Lukas Petkov.
Goal! Elversberg 4, Mainz 0. Cole Campbell (Elversberg) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Nicholas Mickelson.
Goal! Elversberg 4, Mainz 1. Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Second yellow card to Stefan Posch (Mainz) for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Elversberg 4, Mainz 1.
